items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: a snapshot of Ben Webster on the bandstand, sitting in with us, and Leo is right beside him, playing and doing something

ctx.x: twenty feet back, around the edge of the dance floor. And boy, that dance floor really saw some action. And you know who it was?

I became immediately very curious. I wanted to know who that guy was. Because Leo was just carrying on something terrible. He was like a spider monkey, prehensile tail and all. And he was just doing everything. Every time he saw me come in, no matter how many people were there, no matter what was going on, every time he saw me come in to come to work, he'd holler out... He'd be playin', you know, and he'd holler out...he'd stop and he'd stop and he'd say, "Jimmy Fiddler, how's your diddler?" -- and he'd sit down…
So who was the gray-haired man?
